entries.statement: Frozen Level 1-3 remains unchanged: the Lean derivative identity and the Arb enclosure of Gamma are quoted, not re-derived, and no frozen artifact was modified.
Live-region enclosure: every reachable pre-alarm state lies on the two axes or in the open triangle p+m < h-2k, and the region is forward invariant.
entries.notes: Elementary proof; identical to the frozen certificate's reachable_domain. Also checked on the actual grid: the builder raises if a continuation segment escapes.

entries.statement: Uniform killing: P_s(tau <= n) >= q_n(e) for every live s, hence sup_s E_s[tau] <= n/q_n and the resolvent bound ||(I-K_e)^-1|| <= 18.5782.
Odd symmetry F_1(-e) = -F_1(e) is proved analytically by the innovation-negation / arm-swap involution, not assumed and not merely observed numerically.
entries.notes: This is what makes lambda_2 = [F_1'(e*)]^2 legitimate rather than requiring two independent derivative enclosures.

entries.statement: G(e) = E_e[z_tau] is rigorously enclosed at every mesh point; at the mesh the bracket width on G is at most 0.023029.
F_1'(e) is rigorously enclosed over the certified interval: F_1'(I) in [0.32886, 0.91243].
H(e) = F_1(e) + e has exactly one zero in I = [1.028724, 1.044724], and 0 is not in I.
The period-2 multiplier satisfies lambda_2 in [0.10815, 0.83253], so |lambda_2| < 1 and the orbit is locally attracting.
Nothing here concerns the stochastic recursion E_{j+1} = F_1(E_j) + noise: its invariant law, bimodality and any period-2 behaviour of the noisy chain remain untouched.
Only rho = 1 is treated. The rho < 1 branch, the approach to rho_c, m > 1, other (k,h) and non-Gaussian innovations are all untouched.
Uniqueness is asserted only inside the stated interval I. No global uniqueness of the period-2 orbit is asserted.
